task: WI-1 Configuration + Environment coherence — config layer composition + env var coverage matrix
scope: config/*.php (38 files, 4408 LOC, 222 unique env() references)
method_note: 3-perspective analysis (Architect/Security/RED) performed sequentially in-session, not via sub-agent dispatch — Agent/Task tool unavailable in this loadout. Each perspective applied independently to the same primary-source corpus.

findings.summary: Configuration layer is well-structured: 10 production boot guards (AppServiceProvider.php:78-223) all have matching keys in PRODUCTION_ENV_TEMPLATE — no boot-crash deploy gap. Fiscal + loyalty secrets use a lazy-validation pattern (dev_sentinels + min_secret_length) enforced at first sign rather than at boot, which is defensible. Three coverage-asymmetry gaps remain: FCM key-name drift between PROD template and config/services.php, vault.yml.example scope is narrower than the secret surface, and 2 boot-guarded vars are absent from .env.example causing dev friction. No P0 architectural failures.

boot_guards_coverage_matrix.method: For each of 10 production boot guards in AppServiceProvider.php:78-223, verify presence in PRODUCTION_ENV_TEMPLATE.env.txt (P0-blocker if missing), .env.example (dev-friction if missing), and vault.yml.example (deploy-completeness).

results.verdict: MINOR — dev devs setting up local env without prod template won't know default is false; documented in config/idempotency.php:14 PLAN_P11 §2 comment but not surfaced in .env.example
MINOR — same as above; also missing from vault.yml.example secret list

boot_guards_coverage_matrix.comment: All 10 boot-guarded vars present in PRODUCTION_ENV_TEMPLATE — zero P0 deploy boot crash. This is the highest-asymmetry check and it PASSES.

config_layer_composition.total_env_calls_outside_config: 12 unique vars (env() called directly in app/ — Laravel anti-pattern when config:cache is run)

fiscal_secret_branch_override.rationale: Per-branch HMAC rotation feature is silently inert in production after config:cache. Global FISCAL_AUDIT_SECRET still signs (graceful fallback), so chain integrity preserved — but the per-branch rotation runbook documented in docs/FISCAL_SECRETS.md never works.

currency_date_helpers.rationale: Display-only — currency symbol / date pattern fallback to null after config:cache. Laravel's number_format() with null is graceful (outputs digits). Visible UX defect (no € symbol on POS) but not a fiscal bug. Le Cayenne V1 hardcodes EUR in admin so this is dormant.

installer_redirect.rationale: Installer controller — should never run in production (post-install bootstrap). Verify route gated; if accessible, redirect target is null. Out-of-scope for V1 cloud-prep.

demo_flag.rationale: DEMO is in PRODUCTION_ENV_TEMPLATE:201 (DEMO=false) — so $_ENV has it. PROD template includes it. Still anti-pattern but functionally safe.

config_files_with_lazy_secret_validation: config/fiscal.php (dev_sentinels[] + min_secret_length=32, enforced in app/Services/Fiscal/{AuditLogService:310-318, FiscalSealingService:98-106, ZReportService:709-717})
config/loyalty.php (same pattern, enforced lazily by LoyaltyQrSigner — boot guard catches empty secret only)

C_minus_A_breakdown.FCM_SECRET_KEY: TYPO — config/services.php:55 reads env('FCM_SERVER_KEY'), PROD template declares FCM_SECRET_KEY
C_minus_A_breakdown.FCM_TOPIC: TYPO — config/services.php:57 reads env('FCM_TOPIC_PREFIX'), PROD template declares FCM_TOPIC
C_minus_A_breakdown.FISCAL_AUDIT_SECRET_BRANCH_1: USED via dynamic env() in app/Services/Fiscal/AuditLogService.php (per-branch override, see anti-pattern above)
C_minus_A_breakdown.BACKUP_S3_BUCKET: Read by scripts/backup-foodking-daily.sh:16 (infra layer, not Laravel) — OK
C_minus_A_breakdown.STAFF_ONLY_MODE: Read via env() in resources/views/master.blade.php — Blade env() bypass — same anti-pattern P2
C_minus_A_breakdown.TIME_FORMAT, CURRENCY_*, DATE_FORMAT: Read via env() in app/Libraries/AppLibrary.php — anti-pattern P2/P3
C_minus_A_breakdown.MIX_HOST, VITE_PUSHER_*: Frontend build-time env (Laravel Mix / Vite) — OK, not Laravel runtime

set_arithmetic.comment_on_A_minus_C_140: Vast majority are dev/staging-only conveniences (DEMO_*, KIOSK_*, FK_CATALOG_* feature flags, Pakistan-only EASYPAISA_*, ABLY, AWS_ENDPOINT, DYNAMODB_*, PAPERTRAIL_*, MEMCACHED_*, REDIS_URL/CLUSTER/QUEUE legacy aliases). Their absence from PROD template is INTENTIONAL — they fall back to defensive defaults in config/ files. Spot-checked 15 entries; all have safe defaults. Not a P0/P1 finding.

production_env_template_completeness.verdict: GREEN for V1 Le Cayenne single-domain deploy
strengths: Comments tagged with audit-finding IDs (RED-team Wave 5I C.1, GOAL-CMS-2026-05-18 M-R3-P0-C, LCS-S-001) explaining WHY each var matters in prod — best-in-class self-documentation
Boot guard cross-references (AppServiceProvider:85-93 mentioned at PROD template:114) — operator can trace symptom-to-root
ROTATE_openssl_rand_hex_32_PRODUCTION_ONLY placeholders ensure fresh-deploy values are visibly templated — no danger of shipping a dev sentinel
gaps: FCM_SECRET_KEY (line 197) does NOT match config/services.php:55 env('FCM_SERVER_KEY') — silent push degradation (Architect P1, RED-confirmed)
FCM_TOPIC (line 198) similar mismatch with FCM_TOPIC_PREFIX (config/services.php:57) — silent degradation only if FCM activated; OK V1 since FCM is V1.0.2+

KIOSK_DOMAIN, ADMIN_DOMAIN not declared (config/cors.php:6-10 derives allowed_origins from them). For Le Cayenne V1 single-domain (lecayenne.fr) deploy, APP_URL alone is sufficient — OK. For SaaS B2B multi-domain (V2), this becomes a deploy P0.
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET in PROD template but NOT in .env.example (would be a dev/local-test friction — currently optional but should be documented for staging stripe-cli testing)

vault_yml_example_completeness.verdict: PARTIAL — scope is intentionally narrow (DB+Redis+Soketi+Fiscal+backup-alert webhook), but critical secrets remain ungated by Ansible
missing_critical_secrets_from_vault: MIX_API_KEY (CRITICAL per .env.example:57 — all /api/* requires it; absence breaks SPA admin/borne)
PUSHER_APP_ID / PUSHER_APP_KEY / PUSHER_APP_SECRET (Soketi keys ARE in vault, but external Pusher.com fallback isn't)
MAIL_PASSWORD (SMTP credential — silent mail dies if blank)
STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET (vault has a commented stub line 53, currently inactive)
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID / AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY (vault has commented stub lines 47-48, currently inactive)
vault_yml_example_completeness.rationale_for_partial_scope: vault.yml.example comment lines 40-53 explicitly document that Stripe + S3 secrets are forward-looking and currently set in /etc/foodking-backup.env directly. This is a documented architectural choice — not an oversight. Whether to migrate them into the Ansible vault SSOT is an owner decision.

dead_config_findings.claim: Easypaisa stub with empty string values is unreachable
dead_config_findings.rationale: Canonical Easypaisa config lives in config/easypaisa.php (env-driven, 12 keys). config/services.php stub is template-leftover from Laravel scaffold. Easypaisa is a Pakistan-only payment provider; Le Cayenne V1 France-only.
dead_config_findings.recommendation: Remove the stub in V1.0.X cleanup wave to reduce confusion.

dead_config_findings.claim: Paytm-wallet stub with empty string values is unreachable
dead_config_findings.rationale: Paytm is India-only. No grep hits in app/, no controller wires it. Template scaffold leftover.

anti_drift_checks.ssot_pricing_env_layer: config/pricing.php + PRICING_USE_SSOT env (.env.example:29) — PRICING_USE_SSOT=true is the safe default; no boot guard but PricingService::calculateOrder() is the runtime SSOT enforcer. PASS.
anti_drift_checks.fiscal_chain_validation_defaults: config/fiscal.php:96 (chain_validation_enabled) + :117 (sealed_z_guard_enabled) + :138 (kiosk_auto_allocate_sequence) all default to true via filter_var(env(...), FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOLEAN, FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE) ?? true — null-on-failure protects against accidental disable from typos. PASS.
anti_drift_checks.idempotency_required_routes_drift: config/idempotency.php:25-71 has 24 explicit route patterns. config/idempotency.php:34-41 comment documents the GOAL-CMS-2026-05-18 C-P0-H heal sentinel (IdempotencyRequiredRoutesCoverageTest) which catches drift between routes/api.php `idempotency` middleware declarations and this list. Wave E-1 added redeem-loyalty (line 70) via that sentinel. PASS — drift protection is sentinel-enforced.
anti_drift_checks.boot_guard_order_in_appserviceprovider: Order in AppServiceProvider::boot(): POS_SIMULATION_HARDWARE → PAYMENT_BYPASS → PRINTING_BYPASS → APP_DEBUG → IDEMPOTENCY → LOYALTY_QR → APP_URL → BROADCAST_DRIVER → QUEUE → CACHE_DRIVER. Order is NOT alphabetical; clusters by P0 severity (fiscal first, then UX/dev-flag, then infra). PASS — defensible by severity grouping.

findings.verdict: GREEN — configuration architecture is production-safe for V1 Le Cayenne single-domain deploy. Zero P0 boot-crash gaps. 7 recommendations span P1 doc fixes (FCM rename), P2 dev-friction (.env.example completeness), V1.0.2 anti-pattern cleanup (env() in app/), and one owner decision (vault.yml scope). No findings block V1 cloud-prep merge.
